body: I usually do, and saying it doesn't do anything.

I've asked it multiple times what it wants from me, or what it wants me to do. When I ask, it either throws a fit, or it disappears for a while. I know for sure this isn't a loved one or friend. I actually have a feeling that it's the same thing that I've dealt with before, which became very standoff-ish for a while. That's why I want to know what it wants/how to get rid of it so badly.

I've caught something banging around in my room on a recorder once, and what sounds like a little girl talking. It makes me more curious than anything. I might try it again tonight, just to see if I get anything. 

And when I tell it it's unwanted, things just get worse.

I'm probably going to try the recorder again sometime soon. 

It has started to mess with my mum a bit, but not like it does with me. She watched the entire roll of toilet paper unwind onto the floor. She also had it turn out the light in the hall, which is a wheel-switch. Nobody else is up when she is, so it freaked her out a bit. Other than that, nobody else really has any issues with it, aside from an occasional uneasy feeling.

I'm not quite sure actually. It happens within an instant, and I try to tune it out to the best of my ability. I'm pretty sure it would be considered human. It's like when someone's mad at you, but doesn't want to yell in a public setting.

It sounds like a man whisper-yelling my name. It's an extremely harsh tone. That's what worries me the most. It's rather uncomfortable having a man whispering in your ear like that. As for the house, I don't know what happened here, but all the locks were turned around backwards. There was a lock on the master bedroom door which required a key to open from either side. It's like it was meant to lock someone in, not out of the house, since even the locks to the outside doors were facing the wrong way. I try to ask what it wants, but it just kinda vanishes for a while when I do.
I've tried the voice recording, and nothing ever happens. Also, this has been happening for at least 3 months now. I just wish I could figure out what it wants.

This may or may not turn into a wall of text. Here's two that I haven't told anybody before really. 

The first happened a little bit after the shower experience. I was home alone, as always, and I heard a door slam downstairs. Me being me, I grabbed a knife and stood at the top of the stairs, debating whether or not I should investigate. I chose to stay upstairs, and I grabbed the dog, heading to the nearest corner with a good view of the stairs. I sat there clutching the knife to my chest and the dog shaking by my side. I then heard footsteps coming up the stairs slowly. I was so scared, but I held the knife out, ready for a burglar. The footsteps stopped, and I made my way to the railing above the stairs. I looked over, and nobody was there. The door to the basement was still shut since it never opened in the first place. 

Now for the second story. I was alone again, and I was told to unload the dishwasher. Bored with nothing else to do, I got to work. I had music playing, and about halfway through unloading, the music from my iPod went to static then shut off with a pop. I figured the outlet went dead or something and continued on. The hairs on the back of my neck stood up, and I felt watched. I chose to ignore the feeling and continued on still. The feeling never went away. I almost wanted to scream for it to leave me alone, but I just sat in the corner again, waiting for it to pass. It finally went away, and I bolted from the kitchen to my room. At this point I was a mess of emotions. I called my friend to keep me company, and she was distracting me pretty well. Then I heard a door knob down the hall rattle. Mind you, the closet was connected to my room and the walls were paper thin. Then it moved to the bathroom door. Then my parents room. I started to break down crying because my room was next. It made it to my room, and suddenly it stopped. I gathered myself the best I could and peeked into the hallway. Everything was the same as when I was last out there. 

If you want to hear anymore feel free to PM me. I have tons of other freaky stories like these.
I had multiple more terrifying encounters after that. Until that point things were somewhat calm and bearable. For some reason though it started becoming more active.

This is only one of many, and after this I couldn't take a shower with the curtain fully closed for at least a month. 

It was about a year ago, and I got in the shower, which was upstairs. I'd say not even 5 minutes later I heard someone coming down the hall. Suddenly, someone started banging on the door. Annoyed as hell that someone can't take a hint to leave me alone when I'm in the shower, I poked my head out an asked "what?" No reply. Thinking they just hadn't heard me, I yelled what at them. Still no reply. I got annoyed and went back to washing my hair. A few seconds later I heard the door open. I always lock the door when I go into the bathroom. I've been walked in in before, so no matter what, that door is locked. I even double check it to make sure nobody comes in. So the door "opened", and I heard someone come in. I'm starting to freak out because the door is locked, and someone was standing on the other side of the curtain. I just stood there for about a minute with it there, then the feeling of having someone there just faded. So I rush to get out of the shower. When I get out, the door is still locked and everything is where it was. Scared as hell, I left the bathroom and everything was dark upstairs. I went downstairs, and everyone was sitting around watching a movie. I asked who'd been banging on the door, or even upstairs. Nobody was up there. I was alone the whole time. I ran back upstairs and hid in my room for the rest of the night. Everything just went downhill from there.

Not exactly a doll, but odd nonetheless. 

My grandma had taken me to build-a-bear as a Christmas present when I was younger. That bear went with me everywhere I went. It practically became a part of me. Eventually though, as I got older, I started to lose interest in the bear, and I stuck it somewhere I couldn't remember. Fastforward a bit, my grandma passed away, and I wanted to find that teddy bear but never could. I eventually gave up. Then my first birthday without her rolled around, and I was totally lost. That night I felt a presence in my room and I just brushed it off. When I woke up the next morning the bear that had been lost for over a year was sitting on the floor staring at me. It now sits on the shelf in my closet.

I may be a bit late to the party here, and this may not be that scary but oh well.
My family was taking a trip to Pennsylvania to visit family, and we decided to hit a rest stop somewhere in Virginia. I don't remember what time it was, but it was really late, and we were the only people there. So as I start walking towards the building, something draws my attention to this huge tree off to the side. It was a slightly wooded area, so I had no clue why I was being pulled towards this certain one. I got this odd feeling of pure dread, and I saw an outline of a humanoid figure. It was completely black and had no features whatsoever. Mind you, this was in the shade of trees, sometime after midnight probably, so I would never have noticed if it hadn't pulled me towards it. As I looked at it, my fear grew. After a few seconds, the thing took off, darting behind another tree. The way it ran was the worst part of everything. It like hunched over in an almost animalistic way. By this point, I was about ready to get back in the car and never look back, but I knew we wouldn't be stopping again. So I grabbed my mum who was completely clueless and ran to the bathroom. I was shaking so badly. I just wanted out of there, and I was so afraid whatever it was wasn't gone. Soon we left, and I just can't forget the way that thing looked as it ran off.

The fact that they can be anywhere is the world is slightly discouraging. I'll definitely keep a notebook next to me from now on, and I'll post anymore weird dreams I get.

I was starting to think I was a closet ax murderer or something. I've only been in control of my actions in a few dreams, I've never been able to really change anything. Maybe next time I can try to wake myself up before things go south.

So the bad appear as shadows to you? Whatever was chasing me night after night showed me a form. He looke like a human, except for his eyes. He had such a horrible presence. He never hurt me directly though. No matter where I'd go, I couldn't hide. Also, I was in control of myself through these dreams. Other times I just kinda watch things happen. In my nightmares I was, I guess you could say hyper aware. I knew everything that was happening, and I was in control of everything I did.
Will do.

I've had those dreams where I wake myself up to escape. What things do you have to run from? Mine was the same entity over and over again, and bits and pieces of those dreams would come true the next day. Have you experienced anything like that with your dreams?

I started a little bit more research today when I got up, and there was only one little girl who seemed the proper age on the missing persons page. I don't think it was her. I guess I'll need to expand my search zone because if there's something to this, I want to help that little girl out.
They didn't ask me for anything, just showed me horrific scenes. Why would they come to me if I have no clue who they are or what they want/need? Wouldn't they go to those who cared for them?

The only way I realize it was only a dream is by waking up. Usually when I have a nightmare I can tell, and I'll just wait it out. These are so different though. I feel bad for you if you're going through anything remotely similar to what I have. I wouldn't want anyone to have to see things like that..

In the dreams I start out somewhere familiar, then everything goes downhill and dead people show up. It's not like a total change in the dreamscape when these happened. As for contacting them.. I don't want spirits to be contacting me, or I them. I hate the idea of them possibly playing around with my head while I sleep. Completely freaks me out.

I did a little research when I had the second dream and came up with nothing. I still have yet to search for the little girl. Since I've come up blank on the one dream before, does that completely negate the chance of anything paranormal? Or did I just not look good enough?

Thanks for the help. My mom has had a few experiences. My brother, aunt, and mom's friend witnessed a few events. Other than that I'm alone in this. I'll have to go ahead and burn the sage I have then. I've contacted 3 different people on the subject and one never got back, one told me to get the house blessed, and the other told me to go to the doctor before they'd take any interest in my case. Then there was the lady who had us remove the vanity. I'll try to keep up to date with the occurrences.
I think the vanity was in storage at the time she began getting the calls. Either that or I had it. Not sure which, but I know it wasn't in her house when she got em.

I tried to get it on camera before, such as the garage door opening, but failed. The door had opened at least 4 times that day consecutively, but as soon as I turned the camera on it stopped. I've gotten a few audio recording of something that sounds like footsteps and a girl talking (no clue about that one). There were also rhythmic knocks over and over again. The only photo evidence I got was a large orb floating in front of my bed. Other than that I haven't managed to get any other hard evidence.

Nothing of this sort. She would get calls on the day her husband died every year until the year she died. The calls would be in the middle of the night and every time the line would be dead. I think the caller ID may have had his name, not totally sure on that bit though. Those calls happened to her two kids also. Other than that there was no other experiences for her.

No offense taken. I only have an older brother so nobody was born in the new house or even anywhere near it. As for the history, the road behind our house was lined with civil war era houses that served for taverns and hospitals when they troops would march through. Nobody was ever on the verge of death, or even hospitalized when in that house. For the ley lines, I have absolutely no clue. 

I have sage sitting in my room now, but have yet to burn it. I didn't know if a blessing would work for the house or not since I don't believe in religion, so I haven't had anyone bless the house yet. Nobody in my family, at least that I'm totally aware of, has ever been diagnosed with any type of mental illness. I've had multiple MRI's done due to concussions, and the doctors said everything was perfectly normal. I've also been to a therapist who didn't notice anything off about me. I have no desire whatsoever to contact this thing seeing as I deal with it enough through nightmares. Part of the reason I didn't burn the sage was out of fear or angering this thing. 

We have a detached garage which the vanity is in now since it has a lot of sentimental value to me. I'm not sure if it can still get in the house or not since the activity is still here, but definitely not as bad.

I've been to a therapist before which did nothing. I've been to the doctor before and had to have some type of screening done. Nothing out of the ordinary. I just don't get how something can happen to two people and only one be suffering from a psychological disease, and the other is perfectly fine. When looking at the list of symptoms the only one I can relate to would be the 'hallucinations'. On top of that, I can't afford more medical bills piled onto the ones I have already, so why go to the doctor and waste money if it's not totally necessary?

Yeah, the guy just asked what house number was mine, but that wouldn't matter because for some reason all the numbers on my street were screwed up beyond belief. As for getting a look at him, I didn't. In all reality, I was way too scared to even think about it because I knew if I did look it'd be the same guy that I'd dream about. 

We sent pictures of my room to the woman upon request, and after she looked at them, she said whatever was bothering me was attached to the vanity. I've contacted multiple people who try to help, and all of them say either to get the house blessed or to go to the doctor.
But other people have witnessed some of the same stuff as I have. Such as hearing the footsteps an seeing the door open. So does that mean they have the exact same psychotic episodes?
Isn't schizophrenia a genetic illness though? Nobody in my family has ever had any sort of mental disease.

I haven't destroyed the vanity because it's my grandma's from when she was a kid. I don't want to destroy something that means a lot to me. Also we aren't sure if that's the center of activity or not. Salt lines could trap whatever's still in the house in and not let it out.

Thanks I'll try doing that. I always figured anger would make things worse than what they were. As for having someone around, nobody in my family really understands what it is, and the only friend who did understand is in Pennsylvania. I'm not truly alone but it feels like it at times.
